title: When the selected location(s) hold no in-stock parts on the resolved date, the no-data message shows
refs: specs/inventory-value.md Story 7 S7-N2; §7 User Feedback Summary
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A location you can access holds no in-stock (positive-quantity, non-core) parts.
custom_steps:
1. Scope the Location filter to only the empty location.
2. Read the data area.
custom_expected: 1. The report shows the no-data message "Empty bays, endless possibilities. Get Going!" instead of rows, and no totals row.
